mapper.select:
select , nvl(sum(s.stock_qty), 0) as stock_qty, nvl(sum(s.stock_qty), 0) as total_qty from tb_goods g
left join tb_warehouse_stock s on g.goods_no = s.goods_no where g.use_yn = 'Y' group by order by g.goods_no desc

select , nvl(sum(s.stock_qty), 0) as stock_qty, nvl(sum(s.stock_qty), 0) as total_qty from tb_goods g
left join tb_warehouse_stock s on g.goods_no = s.goods_no where g.use_yn = 'Y'
and (g.goods_name like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or g.goods_code like '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
group by order by g.goods_no desc

select , nvl(tot.total_qty, 0) as total_qty,
nvl(wh.wh_qty, 0) as stock_qty
nvl(tot.total_qty, 0) as stock_qty
from tb_goods g
left join ( select goods_no, sum(stock_qty) as total_qty from tb_warehouse_stock group by goods_no ) tot on tot.goods_no = g.goods_no
left join ( select goods_no, stock_qty as wh_qty from tb_warehouse_stock where warehouse_no = #{warehouseNo} ) wh on wh.goods_no = g.goods_no
where g.use_yn = 'Y'
and (g.goods_name like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or g.goods_code like '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
and g.category_no = #{categoryNo}
order by g.goods_no desc
